**Evaluating duplication behavior**

I'm considering how to handle duplication in the constructor. It seems undesirable to always implement duplication when toggling the mode. I have to satisfy multiple assignments since new keys with the same value can conflict with old tests. It's challenging to keep both old and new behaviors exact, so it's essential to preserve existing assignments based on test input. I might also need a helper function to check and repair issues with duplication during deletion.
